node.title: 00H — Reference Failure Scenario and Quality-Gate Plan: Batch Opportunity Beyond Authority ("The Quiet Four Thousand")
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: Reader-facing stories — "The Quiet Four Thousand" first, "The Refund Campaign Nobody Approved" as adversarial hardening · The base story — no attacker is required · The opposite silent failure — discovery without preservation.

relations: Event intelligence may reveal a valuable opportunity while action remains outside the current mandate; preserving the finding and authorizing the campaign are separate steps.
Es una aplicación propuesta del escenario ficticio, no una imputación sobre campañas realizadas en el caso.
